lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi, I saw your ad on TV. I got hit by a forklift at the warehouse where I work.
I'm sorry. When was this, and how are you doing now?
About three weeks ago. I broke my ankle and hurt my knee. I had surgery, and now I'm in therapy three times a week.
Thank you for telling me. Does your employer have workers' comp?
No. HR said they don't carry it. I filed a complaint with OSHA.
Thank you. I'm flagging this for an attorney today. Grant Whitaker can call you at ten. Does that work?
Great. I'm texting you a summary and Grant's name.
